$comment: English is the source catalogue. Every other locale is a translation of this file and falls back to it per-key (see i18n/request.ts), so a string not yet translated renders in English rather than as a raw key. Namespaces are extracted surface by surface: nav + languageSwitcher first (they appear on every page), the rest as each surface is migrated off inline strings.

nav.faucetDesc: Get SOL, mock USDC/USDT and OPEN for testing on devnet
nav.becomeMerchantDesc: The bond, a payment account, and where you stand on each
nav.stakingDesc: Bond OPEN as a merchant, node, or arbitrator
nav.arbitrateDesc: Work a dispute case and cast your ruling
nav.earningsDesc: What your node, oracle or gateway has earned
nav.counterpartiesDesc: Who you trade with, and how often

footer.tagline: A decentralized marketplace for stablecoins and local fiat. No operator holds your money, and no company can suspend you.
footer.noValue: tokens and balances here have no value

exchange.heroTitle: {buying, select, true {Buy {asset} with {fiat} via P2P} other {Sell {asset} with {fiat} via P2P}}
exchange.heroDescription: Trade stablecoins peer-to-peer. Escrow is locked on Solana before you pay; OpenFiat never holds your fiat.
exchange.openTitle: OPEN is in presale — it has no peer-to-peer market until mainnet
exchange.namedNull: Could not ask this node which assets it names, so the book below is unfiltered. This says nothing about which assets are traded — only that we could not ask.
exchange.namedEmpty: This node names no assets, so there is nothing to filter the book by. Advertisements are still shown, each against the mint address it carries.
exchange.bookError: Could not read the advertisement book from the node
exchange.emptyPair: {hasAsset, select, true {Nobody is advertising {asset}/{fiat} yet.} other {Nobody is advertising anything in {fiat} yet.}}
exchange.emptyBody: This market is empty rather than closed. The first merchant in a corridor sets the price and takes every order in it — if you can settle {fiat}, that could be you.
exchange.tryDifferentPair: Or trade a different pair — try another asset or currency above.

orderPanel.clusterUnreachable: Could not reach the cluster — unverified, not unbacked
orderPanel.merchantNoAddress: Merchant identity carries no Solana address
orderPanel.escrow: {buying, select, true {Your {asset} is locked in escrow on Solana the moment an order is placed — before you send any {fiat}. It is released to you once the merchant confirms receipt, and if they do not, an arbitrator decides.} other {Your {asset} moves into escrow on Solana when an order is placed and is released to the buyer only after you confirm their {fiat} arrived.}}
orderPanel.reservationNote: Reviewing comes next, and placing the order signs a reservation against this advertisement. A reservation holds the merchant's liquidity for 30 minutes and lapses on its own if the trade has not moved by then.
orderPanel.quoteTitle: The quote refreshes on this countdown; a floating ad reprices against the oracle mid.
orderPanel.receiveIntoHelp: The buyer sees these details field by field, so they can copy each one rather than retyping it.
orderPanel.reviewOrder: {buying, select, true {Review buy order} other {Review sell order}}
orderPanel.noPriceBlocker: This advertiser prices against an oracle read that hasn't happened yet — there is nothing to quote.
orderPanel.needAccountNone: You have no saved payment account yet — add one in Settings so the buyer knows where to send the money.
orderPanel.needAccountWrongMethod: None of your saved accounts uses a method this advertiser accepts. Add one that does in Settings.
orderPanel.onlyAvailable: Only {amount} is available on this ad
orderPanel.noVaultBlocker: This advertiser has no liquidity vault for the token this ad settles in — nothing on chain backs it
orderPanel.vaultHoldsOnly: This advertiser's vault holds only {amount} {asset} available
